builds.goal: Reference for Lillia: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A mobile sustained spell fighter who maintains Q movement stacks, clips enemies with its outer edge, and uses applied dust for sleep setups. She prefers repeated passes through a fight. Maintain Q movement stacks and outer-edge hits. Sleep setup requires applied dust; a movement/tank route must preserve enough mana and magic threat to matter. Health/AP and repeated damage test longer contact without buying mana.
builds.summary: Health/AP and repeated damage test longer contact without buying mana.
testPlan: Kit question for Lillia: Maintain Q movement stacks and outer-edge hits. Sleep setup requires applied dust; a movement/tank route must preserve enough mana and magic threat to matter.

Start with the early core (Liandry, then Riftmaker) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health/AP and repeated damage test longer contact without buying mana. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Rylai does not stack additively with every existing slow; Riftmaker needs combat ramp.

kitEvidence.formula:
Lillia causes all enemy champions with Dream Dust to become Drowsy for [1.5] seconds. Afterward, they fall Asleep for [2.5 / 2.75 / 3] seconds.

When awakened by damage, they take an additional [100 / 150 / 200 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

Lillia lobs a swirlseed overhead, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage where it lands and revealing and Slowing them by [40]% for [3] seconds. If no enemies are hit, the seed rolls until it hits an enemy or collides with terrain.

Lillia's Abilities apply Dream Dust, dealing @DotPercentTooltip@ max Health magic damage over [3] seconds. Lillia restores @MonsterHealTT@ Health over the duration against large jungle monsters, and restores @ChampionHealTT@ Health against champions.

Lillia's Abilities apply Dream Dust, dealing [(5 + (0.0125) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage over [3] seconds. Lillia restores [(6.5 + (0.025) × AP) × (6)] Health over the duration against large jungle monsters, and restores [(characterLevelInterpolation(1 → 15; raw flags preserved) + (0.05) × AP) × (6)] Health against champions.

Passive: Lillia's Ability hits grant [0.03 / 0.04 / 0.05 / 0.06 / 0.07 + (0.0003) × AP] Move Speed for [6.5] seconds, stacking up to [4] times.

Active: Lillia whirls her censer, dealing [35 / 45 / 55 / 65 / 75 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage, plus an additional [35 / 45 / 55 / 65 / 75 + (0.35) × AP] true damage at the outer edge.
Lillia winds up a huge strike, dealing [80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage. Enemies in the center take [(80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 + (0.35) × AP) × (3)] damage instead.

builds.summary: Test center strike ambush against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test center strike ambush against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Watch Out! Eep!'s center triples its magic damage, making R sleep a setup for a precise W and Rocketbelt approach. Lich Bane rewards one post-cast attack while Shadowflame improves low-health magic/true packets; Q edge true damage remains a separate component.
testPlan: Required state: Sleep lands and allies do not wake the target before centered W.
Compare centered versus edge W and track the single wake bonus.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Premature wake or displacement loses the triple center hit.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Sleep does not multiply every subsequent hit, and magic penetration cannot amplify Q edge true damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Rocketbelt, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
